name: Mental Assault
disable: DC 48 Thievery check (legendary) to deface the symbols or Dispel Magic (10th rank, counteract DC 48) to counteract the trap.
reset: The trap resets automatically if triggered and doesn't reset if disabled.

items.name: Shatter Mind
items.text:
Trigger A creature attempts to Pick the Lock

---

Effect The triggering creature takes 8d10+44 mental damage (DC 42 basic Will save). On a failed save, it's additionally Confused for 1 minute.

text: Magic sigils Hidden in the grain of the wooden door trigger a magic trap that damages the mind of anyone attempting to pick the door's lock.
